entities.name: ledgerRead
entities.text: /-- Rev 6: the one ledger read, `diagnosis-context` (P:755). `prepare-diagnosis` (P:769) and `production-readiness` (P:797) decide from it, before any injury is known. Order error 3: `route!` reads the ledger a second time (P:923-925), and that read has no state here. A runtime that reads twice conforms only while the two reads agree. M6a is to make `route!` use the context's read. -/

entities.name: activeSetUnavailable
entities.text: /-- Rev 6, row #5: the ledger loaded, but `ledger/active-injuries` did not return `:computed` (P:786, `:diagnosis-active-set-unavailable`). A terminal refusal. -/

entities.name: retryClick
entities.text: /-- Rev 7: the start of a retry click. Its options carry `:meta-repair-retry` (S:989-995): the child of a parent that ended `:awaiting-retry`, launched only after the parent click is durably complete. It makes no ledger read of its own and no diagnosis (R:473-477). It carries the acceptance observation `:acceptance-retry-not-prepared` (#22), which is typed, not a state. -/

entities.name: retryReady
entities.text: /-- Rev 7: `attributable-retry-readiness` (P:896-915) returns `:ready` with the attribution. The retry then runs ordinary work (R:500-502), and `route!` is not called. -/
